--- title: "Most draft-eligible college seasons end without an NFL outcome" date: "2026-10-24" description: "Only 3.6% of draft-eligible college player-seasons end in a draft selection and 8.3% in NFL entry, more entrants arrive undrafted than drafted, the per-season entry chance rises from 4.1% to 20.4% by the fourth eligible season, and the drafted share fell from 5.9% (2012 class) to 2.6% (2025)." followups: - "Evaluate out-of-time models with calibration metrics, since the positive class is rarer in later draft classes than in training data." - "Include the eligible-season index as a model term; the entry hazard varies fourfold across it." - "Treat made-roster and rookie-games as a separate second-stage prediction problem, not a footnote on entry." author: - "AI directed by Nick Giangreco" freeze: auto vignette: > %\VignetteIndexEntry{Most draft-eligible college seasons end without an NFL outcome} %\VignetteEngine{quarto::html} %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8} --- ::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"} *Data as of the `data-latest` release, retrieved 2026-10-24. Draft classes after the last complete draft are administratively right-censored and carry no outcomes, so they are excluded from every rate below rather than counted as failures.* ::: ## 1. Introduction A model that forecasts who reaches the NFL has to beat the trivial forecast that nobody does, which is right for 91.7% of draft-eligible college seasons, so this post measures that base rate and its parts, with Joe Burrow, Cam Ward, Jordan Travis, Shane Buechele, and Kyle Allen as running examples. + *Expecting the draft to be rare, under five percent of eligible seasons.* + *Expecting undrafted free-agent entry to rival the draft as an NFL route.* + *Expecting exhausted eligibility to be the most common end-of-season status.* + *Expecting the chance of NFL entry to rise over a player's eligible seasons.* + *Expecting NFL outcome prevalence to be roughly stable across draft classes.* + *Expecting most entrants to appear on an NFL roster in their entry year.* ## 2. Data ### 2.1 Every eligible season ends in exactly one of five statuses A **player-season** is one player's college season with a recorded stat line, **eligible** when the following draft comes at least three years after his high-school graduation; the table defines the five ways an eligible season can end. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} status_terms <- tribble( ~Status , ~`NFL entry` , ~Definition , "Drafted" , "Yes" , "Selected in the NFL draft held the spring after the season, reported by round: round 1, rounds 2 to 3, rounds 4 to 7." , "Signed as an undrafted free agent" , "Yes" , "Not selected in that draft, but on an NFL roster within the entry window afterward (matched by a guarded name lookup)." , "Still playing next season" , "No" , "Back on a college roster the next season; the season is one more turn of the eligibility clock, not an outcome." , "Exhausted eligibility undrafted" , "No" , "The player's last observed college season, with no draft selection and no NFL roster appearance after it." , "Left the data early" , "No" , "Absent the next season although his record says a next season should exist (a transfer with sitting time, an injury retirement, or an unobserved departure); the outcome is unknown." ) kable( status_terms, caption = "The five end-of-season statuses. NFL entry means drafted or signed as an undrafted free agent." ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: The five end-of-season statuses. NFL entry means drafted or signed as an undrafted free agent. |Status |NFL entry |Definition | |:---------------------------------|:---------|:------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| |Drafted |Yes |Selected in the NFL draft held the spring after the season, reported by round: round 1, rounds 2 to 3, rounds 4 to 7. | |Signed as an undrafted free agent |Yes |Not selected in that draft, but on an NFL roster within the entry window afterward (matched by a guarded name lookup). | |Still playing next season |No |Back on a college roster the next season; the season is one more turn of the eligibility clock, not an outcome. | |Exhausted eligibility undrafted |No |The player's last observed college season, with no draft selection and no NFL roster appearance after it. | |Left the data early |No |Absent the next season although his record says a next season should exist (a transfer with sitting time, an injury retirement, or an unobserved departure); the outcome is unknown. | ::: ::: ### 2.2 The risk set counts seasons, while each NFL event falls on one season per player A player usually contributes several eligible seasons, so the table counts more seasons than players, and each player's NFL entry, if any, falls on exactly one of them. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} risk_set <- tibble( Measure = c("Eligible player-seasons", "Distinct players"), Count = format(c(n_risk, n_players), big.mark = ",") ) kable( risk_set, caption = "The risk set: eligible seasons with an observed outcome." ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: The risk set: eligible seasons with an observed outcome. |Measure |Count | |:-----------------------|:------| |Eligible player-seasons |68,993 | |Distinct players |36,223 | ::: ::: ## 3. Results ### 3.1 Fewer than four in every hundred eligible seasons end in a draft selection *Expectation: the draft is rare, under five percent of eligible seasons.* ✅ Out of every 100 eligible seasons, 3.6 end drafted and 8.3 in NFL entry by either route; the table and figures give each outcome with its 95 percent confidence interval, the range the true rate plausibly occupies (Wilson's method), and split the draft by round. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ledger <- bind_rows( tibble( Outcome = c( "Drafted, any round", " Drafted, round 1", " Drafted, rounds 2 to 3", " Drafted, rounds 4 to 7", "Signed as an undrafted free agent", "NFL entry (drafted or UDFA)" ), n_event = c( sum(risk$outcome_drafted_d), sum(risk$outcome_drafted_d & risk$outcome_draft_round_d == 1L), sum(risk$outcome_drafted_d & risk$outcome_draft_round_d %in% 2:3), sum(risk$outcome_drafted_d & risk$outcome_draft_round_d >= 4L), sum(risk$outcome_signed_udfa_d), sum(risk$outcome_nfl_entry_d) ) ) ) |> dplyr::rowwise() |> transmute( Outcome, Events = format(n_event, big.mark = ","), `At risk` = format(n_risk, big.mark = ","), Prevalence = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * n_event / n_risk), `95% CI` = sprintf( "[%.1f%%, %.1f%%]", 100 * wilson(n_event, n_risk)["lo"], 100 * wilson(n_event, n_risk)["hi"] ) ) kable( ledger, caption = "How often each outcome occurs among eligible player-seasons." ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: How often each outcome occurs among eligible player-seasons. |Outcome |Events |At risk |Prevalence |95% CI | |:---------------------------------|:------|:-------|:----------|:------------| |Drafted, any round |2,479 |68,993 |3.6% |[3.5%, 3.7%] | |Drafted, round 1 |317 |68,993 |0.5% |[0.4%, 0.5%] | |Drafted, rounds 2 to 3 |691 |68,993 |1.0% |[0.9%, 1.1%] | |Drafted, rounds 4 to 7 |1,471 |68,993 |2.1% |[2.0%, 2.2%] | |Signed as an undrafted free agent |3,239 |68,993 |4.7% |[4.5%, 4.9%] | |NFL entry (drafted or UDFA) |5,718 |68,993 |8.3% |[8.1%, 8.5%] | ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ledger_plot <- tibble( Outcome = c( "Drafted, any round", "Signed as an undrafted free agent", "NFL entry (drafted or undrafted)" ), n_event = c(n_drafted, n_udfa, n_entry) ) |> rowwise() |> mutate( p = n_event / n_risk, lo = wilson(n_event, n_risk)["lo"], hi = wilson(n_event, n_risk)["hi"] ) |> ungroup() |> mutate( Outcome = reorder(Outcome, p), drafted = Outcome == "Drafted, any round" ) p_ledger <- ggplot(ledger_plot, aes(100 * p, Outcome)) + geom_vline(xintercept = 5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") + geom_col_interactive( aes( fill = drafted, tooltip = sprintf( "%s: %s of %s eligible seasons (%.1f%%, 95%% CI %.1f%% to %.1f%%)", Outcome, fmt(n_event), fmt(n_risk), 100 * p, 100 * lo, 100 * hi ), data_id = Outcome ), width = 0.65 ) + geom_linerange(aes(xmin = 100 * lo, xmax = 100 * hi), linewidth = 0.8) + geom_text( aes(x = 100 * hi + 0.2, label = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * p)), hjust = 0, size = 4.4 ) + annotate( "text", x = 5.1, y = 0.55, label = "5% line", hjust = 0, size = 4.2 ) + scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#1B9E77", `FALSE` = "gray65")) + guides(fill = "none") + expand_limits(x = 10) + scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x)) + labs( title = "The draft takes fewer than four seasons in a hundred", subtitle = "Share of eligible player-seasons ending in each outcome", x = "Share of eligible seasons", y = NULL, caption = "Whiskers: 95% confidence interval." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p_ledger, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 5) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} by_round <- risk |> filter(outcome_drafted_d) |> count(round = outcome_draft_round_d, name = "n") |> mutate(per100 = 100 * n / n_risk) p_round <- ggplot(by_round, aes(factor(round), per100)) + geom_col_interactive( aes( tooltip = sprintf( "Round %d: %s eligible seasons drafted, %.2f in every 100", round, fmt(n), per100 ), data_id = round ), fill = "#1B9E77", width = 0.7 ) + labs( title = "Every round takes roughly the same thin slice", subtitle = "Eligible seasons drafted in each round, per 100 eligible seasons", x = "Draft round", y = "Per 100 eligible seasons", caption = "Hover a bar for the count." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p_round, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 5) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### 3.2 More NFL entrants arrive undrafted than drafted *Expectation: undrafted free-agent entry rivals the draft as an NFL route.* ✅ The table and the first figure split the 5,718 NFL entries by route and name the route each running example took, showing the undrafted route alone carries 56.6% of entrants, more than all seven rounds combined; the second figure follows the route mix by draft class. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} routes |> arrange(desc(share)) |> transmute( Route = as.character(route), Entrants = fmt(n), Share = pct(share) ) |> kable(caption = "NFL entrants by entry route.") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: NFL entrants by entry route. |Route |Entrants |Share | |:----------------------|:--------|:-----| |Undrafted free agent |3,239 |56.6% | |Drafted, rounds 4 to 7 |1,471 |25.7% | |Drafted, rounds 2 to 3 |691 |12.1% | |Drafted, round 1 |317 |5.5% | ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} cast <- c( "Joe Burrow", "Cameron Ward", "Jordan Travis", "Shane Buechele", "Kyle Allen" ) examples <- risk |> filter(player %in% cast, outcome_nfl_entry_d) |> mutate( Route = if_else( outcome_drafted_d, sprintf( "Drafted, round %d, pick %d", outcome_draft_round_d, outcome_draft_pick_d ), "Undrafted free agent" ) ) |> arrange(draft_year) |> select( Player = player, `Final college season` = season, `Draft class` = draft_year, Route, `Eligible season` = eligible_season_index ) kable( examples, caption = "The running examples at their NFL entry. Eligible season counts the player's draft-eligible college seasons from one." ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: The running examples at their NFL entry. Eligible season counts the player's draft-eligible college seasons from one. |Player | Final college season| Draft class|Route | Eligible season| |:--------------|--------------------:|-----------:|:--------------------------|---------------:| |Kyle Allen | 2017| 2018|Undrafted free agent | 1| |Joe Burrow | 2019| 2020|Drafted, round 1, pick 1 | 3| |Shane Buechele | 2020| 2021|Undrafted free agent | 3| |Jordan Travis | 2023| 2024|Drafted, round 5, pick 171 | 4| |Cameron Ward | 2024| 2025|Drafted, round 1, pick 1 | 3| ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} p_routes <- ggplot(routes, aes(x = 100 * share, y = route)) + geom_col_interactive( aes( tooltip = sprintf("%s: %s entrants (%.1f%%)", route, fmt(n), 100 * share), data_id = route ), width = 0.7, fill = "#1B9E77" ) + geom_text( aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%% (%s)", 100 * share, fmt(n))), hjust = -0.05, size = 4.2 ) + annotate( "text", x = 45, y = 2.2, label = sprintf( "More than half of all entrants\nnever hear their name called:\n%s of %s", fmt(n_udfa), fmt(n_entry) ), size = 4.4, hjust = 0 ) + annotate( "curve", x = 60, y = 2.6, xend = 55, yend = 3.62, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.6 ) + expand_limits(x = 85) + scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x)) + labs( title = "The undrafted route is the largest way into the NFL", subtitle = "Share of NFL entrants by entry route, all eligible seasons", x = "Share of NFL entrants", y = NULL, caption = "Each bar is the route's percent of all entrants; the label lists the count behind it." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p_routes, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 5) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} route_class <- risk |> filter(outcome_nfl_entry_d) |> mutate( route = if_else(outcome_drafted_d, "Drafted", "Undrafted free agent") ) |> count(draft_year, route, name = "n") |> group_by(draft_year) |> mutate(share = n / sum(n)) |> ungroup() p_route_class <- ggplot(route_class, aes(draft_year, n, fill = route)) + geom_col_interactive( aes( tooltip = sprintf( "%d class, %s: %s entrants (%.0f%% of the class's entrants)", draft_year, tolower(route), fmt(n), 100 * share ), data_id = paste(draft_year, route) ), width = 0.75 ) + scale_fill_manual( values = c(Drafted = "#1B9E77", `Undrafted free agent` = "#7570B3") ) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2012, 2025, 2)) + labs( title = "The undrafted route outnumbers the draft in every class from 2016 on except 2021", subtitle = "NFL entrants by entry route and draft class", x = "Draft class", y = "NFL entrants", fill = NULL, caption = "Hover a segment for the count and share." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p_route_class, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 5) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### 3.3 Most eligible seasons end with the player coming back, not with an outcome *Expectation: exhausted eligibility is the most common end-of-season status.* ❌ The table and the first figure give the share of eligible seasons ending in each status: 51.0% end with the player simply coming back, ahead of the 33.1% that end with eligibility exhausted; the second figure splits the statuses by eligible season. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} status_tab |> arrange(desc(share)) |> transmute( Status = as.character(status_label), Seasons = fmt(seasons), Share = pct(share) ) |> undrafted free agent |3,239 |4.7% | |Drafted |2,479 |3.6% | ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} p_status <- ggplot(status_tab, aes(x = 100 * share, y = status_label)) + geom_col_interactive( aes( tooltip = sprintf( "%s: %s seasons (%.1f%%)", status_label, fmt(seasons), 100 * share ), data_id = status_label ), width = 0.7, fill = "#1B9E77" ) + geom_text( aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%% (%s)", 100 * 0 ) + annotate( "curve", x = 62, y = 2.9, xend = 49, yend = 4.62, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.6 ) + annotate( "text", x = 22, y = 1.5, label = sprintf( "NFL ``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} status_idx <- risk |> count(eligible_season_index, status_end_of_season, name = "n") |> group_by(eligible_season_index) |> mutate(share = n / sum(n), seasons = sum(n)) |> ungroup() |> filter(seasons >= 100) |> left_join( distinct(status_tab, status_end_of_season, status_label), by = "status_end_of_season" ) |> mutate( status_label = factor( status_label, levels = levels(status_tab$status_label) ) ) p_status_idx <- ggplot( status_idx, aes(factor(eligible_season_index), 100 * share, fill = status_label) ) + geom_col_interactive( aes( tooltip = sprintf( "Eligible season %d, %s: %.1f%% (%s of %s seasons)", eligible_season_index, status_label, 100 * share, fmt(n), fmt(seasons) ), data_id = paste(eligible_season_index, status_label) ), width = 0.75 ) + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") + labs( title = "Coming back dominates early; exhausted eligibility dominates late", subtitle = "Share of eligible seasons by end-of-season status, by eligible season", x = "Eligible season (1 = first season the player could be drafted after)", y = "Share of eligible seasons (%)", fill = NULL, caption = "Eligible seasons with fewer than 100 player-seasons omitted. Hover a segment for the count." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() + theme(legend.position = "right") girafe(ggobj = p_status_idx, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 5.5) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### 3.4 The chance of entry rises with each eligible season a player waits *Expectation: the chance of NFL entry rises over a player's eligible seasons.* ✅ The **hazard** is the chance that a player still unentered and still playing at a given eligible season is taken by the very next draft; the table and the first figure show it rising from 4.1% in the first eligible season to 20.4% in the fourth, and the second figure repeats it for three eras of draft classes. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} hazard |> transmute( `Eligible season` = eligible_season_index, `Player-seasons` = fmt(seasons), Drafted = pct(outcome_drafted_d), `Undrafted free agent` = pct(outcome_signed_udfa_d), `NFL entry` = pct(outcome_nfl_entry_d) ) |> kable( caption = "Per-season chance of each outcome by eligible season (eligible seasons with fewer than 100 player-seasons omitted)." ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: Per-season chance of each outcome by eligible season (eligible seasons with fewer than 100 player-seasons omitted). | Eligible season|Player-seasons |Drafted |Undrafted free agent |NFL entry | |---------------:|:--------------|:-------|:--------------------|:---------| | 1|36,223 |2.3% |1.8% |4.1% | | 2|21,191 |4.8% |5.3% |10.1% | | 3|9,386 |5.7% |12.0% |17.6% | | 4|2,044 |4.3% |16.1% |20.4% | | 5|144 |1.4% |9.0% |10.4% | ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} hz_tip <- function(k, outcome, p, n) { sprintf( "Eligible season %d, %s: %.1f%% of %s seasons", k, outcome, 100 * p, fmt(n) ) } p_hazard <- ggplot( filter(hazard_long, outcome != "NFL entry"), aes(eligible_season_index, p, color = outcome) ) + geom_line( data = filter(hazard_long, outcome == "NFL entry"), aes(eligible_season_index, p), linewidth = 1.4, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray35" ) + geom_line(linewidth = 1.4) + geom_point_interactive( aes(tooltip = hz_tip(eligible_season_index, outcome, p, seasons)), size = 3 ) + geom_point_interactive( data = filter(hazard_long, outcome == "NFL entry"), aes( eligible_season_index, p, tooltip = hz_tip(eligible_season_index, outcome, p, seasons) ), size = 3, color = "gray35" ) + annotate( "text", x = 2.2, y = 0.225, label = sprintf( "NFL entry (dashed) peaks in the\nfourth eligible season at %.1f%%", 100 * hz(4) ), size = 4.4, hjust = 0 ) + annotate( "curve", x = 3.75, y = 0.225, xend = 3.95, yend = 0.209, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.6 ) + annotate( "text", x = 1.6, y = 0.01, label = "Burrow and Ward drafted in their third eligible season,\nTravis in his fourth", size = 4.4, hjust = 0 ) + annotate( "curve", x = 3, y = 0.022, xend = 3, yend = 0.051, curvature = 0, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.6 ) + annotate( "curve", x = 3.85, y = 0.016, xend = 3.97, yend = 0.038, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.6 ) + scale_y_continuous( labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * x), limits = c(0, 0.25) ) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = hazard$eligible_season_index) + scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") + labs( title = "Waiting raises the chance of entry, mostly through undrafted signings", subtitle = "Per-season chance of each outcome by eligible season", x = "Eligible season (1 = first season the player could be drafted after)", y = "Chance the next draft\nbrings the outcome", color = NULL, caption = "Dashed line: NFL entry (drafted or undrafted). Eligible seasons with fewer than 100 player-seasons omitted." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p_hazard, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} hazard_era <- risk |> mutate( era = cut( draft_year, breaks = c(2011, 2016, 2021, 2025), labels = c( "2012 to 2016 classes", "2017 to 2021 classes", "2022 to 2025 classes" ) ) ) |> group_by(era, eligible_season_index) |> summarise(seasons = n(), p = mean(outcome_nfl_entry_d), .groups = "drop") |> filter(seasons >= 100) p_hazard_era <- ggplot(hazard_era, aes(eligible_season_index, p, color = era)) + geom_line_interactive(aes(data_id = era, tooltip = era), linewidth = 1.3) + geom_point_interactive( aes( data_id = era, tooltip = sprintf( "%s, eligible season %d: %.1f%% entered the NFL (%s seasons)", era, eligible_season_index, 100 * p, fmt(seasons) ) ), size = 3 ) + scale_y_continuous( labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * x), limits = c(0, NA) ) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:5) + scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") + labs( title = "The chance rises through the third eligible season in every era", subtitle = "Per-season chance of NFL entry by eligible season, three eras of draft classes", x = "Eligible season", y = "Chance the next draft\nbrings NFL entry", color = NULL, caption = "Era-season cells with fewer than 100 player-seasons omitted. Hover a line to isolate an era." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p_hazard_era, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 5) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### 3.5 The drafted share of eligible seasons has more than halved across draft classes *Expectation: NFL outcome prevalence is roughly stable across draft classes.* ❌ The table and the first figure follow the drafted share from 5.9% of the 2012 class to 2.6% of 2025 while the pool of eligible seasons grew more than fourfold, with NFL entry jumping at the 2016 class; the second figure shows the counts behind those shares. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} trend |> filter(draft_year %in% c(y0, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2018, 2020, 2022, y1)) |> transmute( `Draft class` = draft_year, `Eligible seasons` = fmt(seasons), Drafted = pct(drafted), `Undrafted free agent` = pct(udfa), `NFL entry` = pct(entry) ) |> kable( caption = "Share of eligible seasons ending in each outcome, selected draft classes." ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: Share of eligible seasons ending in each outcome, selected draft classes. | Draft class|Eligible seasons |Drafted |Undrafted free agent |NFL entry | |-----------:|:----------------|:-------|:--------------------|:---------| | 2012|1,750 |5.9% |2.9% |8.9% | | 2014|2,499 |4.9% |2.5% |7.4% | | 2015|2,646 |4.6% |2.6% |7.2% | | 2016|2,648 |4.8% |7.3% |12.1% | | 2018|5,486 |3.8% |7.2% |11.0% | | 2020|5,874 |3.6% |4.3% |7.9% | | 2022|6,728 |3.2% |5.0% |8.1% | | 2025|8,675 |2.6% |4.1% |6.7% | ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} Summary The base rate a forecasting model has to beat is low and moving: four of six expectations hold, and the two that fail show most seasons are mid-career and the drafted share is falling. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} tribble( ~Expectation , ~Verdict , ~Evidence , "The draft is rare, under 5% of eligible seasons" , "✅" , sprintf("%s drafted; %s NFL entry by either route.", pct(p_drafted), pct(p_entry)) , "Undrafted entry rivals the draft" , "✅" , sprintf("%s of entrants arrive undrafted.", pct(udfa_share)) , "Exhausted eligibility is the most common status" , "❌" , sprintf("%s of seasons end with the player returning; %s exhausted.", pct(st("continuing")), pct(st("exhausted_undrafted"))) , "The entry chance rises with waiting" , "✅" , sprintf("From %s in the first eligible season to %s in the fourth.", pct(hz(1)), pct(hz(4))) , "Prevalence is stable across classes" , "❌" , sprintf("Drafted share %s (%d) to %s (%d).", pct(tr(y0, "drafted")), y0, pct(tr(y1, "drafted")), y1) , "Most entrants make an entry-year roster" , "✅" , sprintf("%s on a roster, but %s play no game.", pct(made_roster), pct(zero_games)) ) |> kable(caption = "Each expectation and what the data showed.") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: Each expectation and what the data showed. |Expectation |Verdict |Evidence | |:-----------------------------------------------|:-------|:----------------------------------------------------------------| |The draft is rare, under 5% of eligible seasons |✅ |3.6% drafted; Discussion ::: {.callout-important} The base rate is not fixed. - The drafted share fell by more than half across the data's span, so a model validated out of time is scored against rarer positives than it trained on. - Calibration curves and precision at fixed recall say more across years than accuracy or raw discrimination figures. ::: ::: {.callout-important} Waiting time carries signal. - The chance of entry varies about 5-fold over the eligible seasons, and the undrafted chance climbs faster than the drafted chance. - Modeling drafted status alone discards that structure, and modeling entry without routes discards the competition between them. ::: ::: {.callout-important} Entry and playing are different questions. - Nearly half of entrants play zero rookie games, so the second-stage labels (made roster, rookie games) are a separate prediction problem, not a footnote on the first. ::: Several caveats bound these figures. - The high-school graduation year is imputed for players without a recruiting record, 59.6% of eligible seasons including Burrow's and Ward's, and the imputation can mis-time redshirts and transfers, shifting rows in and out of the risk set. - The "left the data early" status is informative censoring that the pipeline flags but does not resolve. - The entry-year roster rate is partly mechanical: the undrafted link is defined by roster presence, so an undrafted entrant cannot fail it, and it reads better as a check on the link than as a finding. - Two forces plausibly drive the drafted decline and the 2016 entry jump, though neither is tested here: the stat-line population grows faster than a draft of fixed size, and NFL roster coverage deepens over the years, so the undrafted lookup catches more signings that always happened.
